title: Horror Shark
desc: An accident causes a great white shark to turn into a killing mutant. However, the problem worsens when the beast receives the ability to overpower humans.

title: Wanted
desc: A sharpshooter is caught between a gangster who wants him dead since he knows too much, the police who want him for the information he holds and his girlfriend who yearns for him to mend his ways.

title: Ajay
desc: Manorama falls in love with Ajay, even though they come from different social backgrounds. They want to get married, but Manorama's uncles try their best to separate the happy couple.

title: Haathkadi
desc: ACP Suraj, an honest policeman, swears revenge on culprits when his innocent brother is killed. However, he is soon accused of murder and is remanded to prison.

title: Sardaar Gabbar Singh
desc: The kingdom of Rathanpur is forced to face the wrath of Bhairav Singh, who unceremoniously usurps their land. They later find respite when Gabbar Singh, a brave policeman, takes on their oppressor.

title: Mumbai Ki Kiran Bedi
desc: When an IPS officer is killed by a criminal gang, her father meets her lookalike. He then decides to train her to be just like his daughter in order to avenge her death.
